name: Modulex Construction Technologies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1973, Modulex Construction Technologies Ltd is in production, building, supplying, fabricating and manufacturing of modular steel buildings
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Modulex is a UK-based ConstrucTech company, promoted by Red Ribbon Asset Management Plc. Company deploys technologies like Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain and Internet of Things and green construction technology for development of Modular Buildings 2.O. Company manufactures modules to form a complete Permanent Modular Construction building which are typically constructed indoors on assembly lines. Company offers complete turnkey service viz. Conceptualization and Design, Cost Estimation, Structural Engineering, Offsite- Module Manufacturing & Onsite-Foundation, Module Transportation & Installation, Finishing & Handover, from initial concept design to completion. Company's proprietary technology is a modern method of construction which entails construction of 3D volumetric steel modular buildings
